fields.name: Bimagrumab with semaglutide or tirzepatide
fields.stage: Completed Phase 2 semaglutide results; separate tirzepatide Phase 2 active, not recruiting
fields.summaryToAppend: A separate completed Phase 2 BELIEVE study randomized 507 adults to bimagrumab, semaglutide, their combinations or placebo. The registry has posted results, and the peer-reviewed March 2026 paper reports substantial weight and fat-mass reductions with the combination while largely preserving lean mass relative to semaglutide alone.
fields.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for bimagrumab alone or combined with semaglutide or tirzepatide for weight management.
fields.limitationsToAppend: BELIEVE used intravenous bimagrumab and subcutaneous semaglutide in Phase 2 research; it does not establish an approved regimen, UK authorisation, NICE/NHS access, lawful supply or clinical approval. Lean mass measured by DXA is not the same as muscle strength or function, and the paper reports no significant improvement in grip strength or patient-reported outcomes. The completed semaglutide study and the still-active tirzepatide study remain separate programmes of evidence.
